products.quality: Broadest importer of roster: .ai, .svg, .dxf, .pdf, .plt/.hpgl. No EPS or CDR. Fonts must be installed locally; embedded fonts unsupported.
Identical format list to LightBurn (shared engine): .ai, .svg, .dxf, .pdf, .plt/.hpgl. No EPS/CDR.
SVG only, officially 'in an early state of development', Inkscape-tuned; text and fills unsupported. No DXF/AI/PDF (DXF is a long-open feature request, issue #408).
xTool Studio imports SVG and DXF only; PDF/AI files from third-party apps must be converted before import per official FAQ.
SVG and DXF (DXF capped below 5 MB); also STL for 3D and custom fonts. No AI/PDF/EPS import.
PNG, JPG/JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIF/TIFF. No WebP in the documented list.
Same five formats as LightBurn: PNG, JPG/JPEG, BMP, GIF, TIF/TIFF. No WebP documented.
BMP, JPG, PNG, GIF per official docs; raster-to-G-code conversion is the app's core design. No TIFF/WebP documented.
Widest raster list of roster: JPG, JPEG, GIF, PNG, BMP, WEBP per xTool's import FAQ - only roster product with documented WebP support.
Narrowest: JPG and PNG only, and only via Image Trace (auto-vectorization) or Pro raster toolpaths - no general raster canvas object.
Native .lbrn/.lbrn2; opens MillMage .mage (cross-compatibility stated at MillMage launch); G-code import extracts geometry only, no speed/power. No .crv/.easel/RDWorks import.
Opens .mage, .lbrn and .lbrn2 project files directly. G-code import is not documented on the file-management page. No .crv/.easel.
G-code (.nc/.gcode) load, on-screen preview and streaming is the product's core function. No foreign project-file formats.
Only .xcs project files can be opened from local disk in xTool Studio; the official exhaustive import list contains no G-code, .lbrn or other foreign project formats.
Imports G-code (.nc) with toolpath visualization, but files must first pass through a post-processor to match the Easel G-code spec. No .lbrn/.crv.

Documented SVG-DPI preference and improved DXF spline importer (v1.5), but recurring community reports of DXF scale/unit mis-sizing (25.4x, mm-vs-inch) and spline artifacts; clipboard paste shows 72-vs-96-DPI size drift.
Import controls exist (docs mirror LightBurn's file engine), but the product is too young for community fidelity consensus - quality unknown. Inferred to share LightBurn's importer behavior.

evidence.cite: Docs format lists/UI are verbatim-identical to LightBurn's FileManagement page; same vendor - inferred shared import code, unverified

products.quality: Weak by its own docs: SVG handled 'as is', no text/fonts, no fill (borders only), no per-layer/color handling, tuned to Inkscape output; other editors 'expect some problems'.

xTool Studio documents a per-import DPI setting for SVG sizing, automatic DXF unit detection (toggleable), and Best/High/Medium vector parse quality; a dedicated import-failure troubleshooting FAQ exists. Community consensus on fidelity not established.
Documented hard limits: DXF must be under 5 MB, SVG text elements are not supported, G-code must match the Easel spec. Units/DPI handling not documented.
Universal import dialog, drag-and-drop into canvas, clipboard paste of images and text from other apps, Recent Projects and Recent Templates submenus - fullest import UX of roster.
Drag-and-drop import plus Recent Projects/Recent Templates documented, mirroring LightBurn. Clipboard paste not explicitly documented.
File-open workflow documented; drag-drop, clipboard paste and recent-files behavior not documented anywhere found - unknown.

evidence.cite: lasergrbl.com usage docs reviewed (load-and-send, raster-image-import, user-interface topics) contain no drag-drop/clipboard/recent-files statements

products.quality: Import via file picker with per-import parse options is documented; drag-and-drop and clipboard paste are not evidenced in xTool Studio articles found - beyond-picker UX unknown.
Import tab groups SVG / DXF / Image Trace / G-code entry points; cloud dashboard lists projects. Drag-drop and clipboard paste not documented.
Exports vectors as .ai, .svg or .dxf, plus single-image .png/.jpg/.bmp export; saves .lbrn/.lbrn2 projects (lbrn2 default). Broadest export of roster.
Exports .ai/.svg/.dxf with two DXF dialects (R12 legacy, R2007 modern); saves .mage projects; 'Save GCode or Machine File' varies by controller (GRBL, Smoothieware, Marlin...).
Can save/append generated G-code files for reuse (community tutorials show File save workflow); no vector export - exporting the vectorization result to DXF is an unfulfilled user request.

xTool Studio exports PNG/JPG with selectable 50-1000 DPI plus SVG (Export dialog and canvas right-click); can also export legacy .xcs projects for old-app compatibility. No G-code or DXF export documented.
G-code export documented, but tier-gated: free tier 1 export/week, Starter 20/week, Pro unlimited. No SVG/DXF design export documented; community resorts to workarounds.
No replace-on-reimport or linked-external-file feature in the file-management docs. Nearest capability: the 2.1 Cuttle.xyz parametric-design integration feeds designs into LightBurn.

evidence.cite: https://docs.lightburnsoftware.com/latest/Reference/FileManagement/ documents open/import/export only; no linked-source or update-from-file workflow appears

products.quality: No re-import or update-from-file feature documented on the file-management page.
No project or linked-file concept at all; each image/SVG/G-code load is a one-shot conversion.

evidence.cite: https://lasergrbl.com/usage/ docs set reviewed (load-and-send, raster-image-import); no re-import or linked-source workflow exists in the documentation

products.quality: No re-import/linked-source workflow found in xTool Studio articles; absence not confirmed exhaustively because Studio docs are scattered per-machine support articles.

evidence.cite: https://support.xtool.com/article/2520 and https://support.xtool.com/article/2546 cover import/export only; no update-from-file feature located

products.quality: Cloud projects auto-save, but no external linked-file or replace-on-reimport workflow is documented in the import/export article set.

evidence.cite: https://support.easel.com/hc/en-us/sections/42822691403027-File-Importing-and-Exporting section reviewed via search; no re-import/linked-source article exists
